nodes.title: Finding arc length using s = (θ/360°) × 2πr or s = rθ (radians).

nodes.label: Volume of a Rectangular Prism (Cuboid)
nodes.title: Using V = length × width × height.

nodes.label: Surface Area of a Rectangular Prism (Cuboid)
nodes.title: Summing areas of all six rectangular faces.

nodes.label: Volume of a Right Circular Cone
nodes.title: Using V = (1/3)πr^2h.

nodes.label: Surface Area of a Right Circular Cone
nodes.title: Using SA = πr^2 + πrl for a closed cone, where l is slant height.

nodes.label: Volume of a Triangular Prism
nodes.title: Using V = (area of triangular base) × length.

nodes.label: Surface Area of a Triangular Prism
nodes.title: Summing areas of two triangular bases and three rectangular faces.

nodes.label: Volume of a Hemisphere
nodes.title: Using V = (2/3)πr^3.

nodes.label: Surface Area of a Hemisphere
nodes.title: Using SA = 3πr^2 for a hemisphere with base included; 2πr^2 without base.

nodes.label: Volume of Composite Solids
nodes.title: Decomposing or combining standard solids to find total volume.

nodes.label: Surface Area of Composite Solids
nodes.title: Calculating exposed surface area of combined solids, accounting for internal interfaces.

nodes.label: Prism Nets
nodes.title: Constructing and analyzing 2D nets that fold to form prisms.

nodes.label: Cylinder Net
nodes.title: Representing a cylinder as a rectangle with two circular ends.

nodes.label: Cone Net
nodes.title: Representing a cone as a circular sector and a circular base.

nodes.label: Trapezoidal Rule for Area Approximation
nodes.title: Approximating the area under a curve or irregular boundary by summing areas of trapezoids.

nodes.label: Polynomial expression
nodes.title: An algebraic expression comprised of terms with variables raised to non-negative integer powers, combined using addition and subtraction.

nodes.label: Degree of polynomial
nodes.title: The highest power of the variable in a polynomial expression.

nodes.label: Addition and subtraction of polynomials
nodes.title: Combining like terms by adding or subtracting their coefficients.

nodes.label: Multiplying polynomial expressions (Expanding)
nodes.title: Using the distributive property to multiply polynomials and combine like terms.

nodes.label: Perfect square trinomials
nodes.title: Polynomials of the form $(x+a)^2 = x^{2} + 2ax + a^{2}$ and $(x-a)^2 = x^{2} - 2ax + a^{2}$.

nodes.label: Difference of two squares
nodes.title: The factorization of expressions in the form $a^{2} - b^{2} = (a - b)(a + b)$.

nodes.label: Polynomial long division
nodes.title: A division algorithm for dividing one polynomial by another to obtain a quotient and remainder.

nodes.label: Polynomial functions
nodes.title: Functions defined by polynomials where the dependent variable depends on the independent variable according to a polynomial expression.

nodes.label: Evaluating polynomial functions
nodes.title: Computing the value of a polynomial function by substituting the independent variable and simplifying.

nodes.label: Factoring polynomials by grouping
nodes.title: Factorization technique grouping terms to factor out common factors.

nodes.label: Factoring quadratic polynomials
nodes.title: Expressing a quadratic polynomial as a product of two linear factors using factor pairs or the quadratic formula.

nodes.label: Factor theorem
nodes.title: The polynomial $f(x)$ has a factor $(x - k)$ if and only if $f(k) = 0$.

nodes.label: Partial fractions decomposition
nodes.title: Expressing a rational function as a sum of fractions with simpler denominators, often linear factors.

nodes.label: Manipulating formulae (Make the subject)
nodes.title: Rearranging an equation to make a specified variable the subject of the formula.

nodes.label: Identifying algebraic patterns from sequences
nodes.title: Analyzing sequences via first and second differences to identify linear or quadratic patterns.

nodes.label: Solving linear equations
nodes.title: Finding the value(s) of the variable(s) that satisfy linear equations.

nodes.label: Solving quadratic equations by factorization
nodes.title: Finding roots by expressing the quadratic as a product of linear factors set equal to zero.

nodes.label: Solving quadratic equations by quadratic formula
nodes.title: Using the formula $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$ to find roots of $ax^2 + bx + c=0$.

nodes.label: Solving quadratic equations by substitution
nodes.title: Using substitution to reduce an equation involving powers of variables to a quadratic in a new variable.

nodes.label: Nature of quadratic roots and the discriminant
nodes.title: Determining the nature (real distinct, real equal, complex) of quadratic roots based on discriminant $b^{2}-4ac$.

nodes.label: Forming quadratic equations from roots
nodes.title: Constructing a quadratic equation given its roots using relationships between roots and coefficients.

nodes.label: Completing the square
nodes.title: Rearranging a quadratic expression into the form $a(x-p)^2 + q$ to find vertex form and analyze maxima/minima.

nodes.label: Manipulation and simplification of surds
nodes.title: Reducing surds to simplest form, addition/subtraction, multiplication/division, and rationalizing denominators.

nodes.label: Solving surd equations
nodes.title: Solving equations involving square roots by isolating surds and squaring both sides, checking for extraneous roots.

nodes.label: Definition and properties of radian measure
nodes.title: Measuring angles by the length of the arc on a circle of radius one and relating radians to degrees.

nodes.label: Arc length and sector area in radians
nodes.title: Formulas for arc length $l = r \theta$ and sector area $A = \frac{1}{2} r^{2} \theta$ where $\theta$ is in radians.

nodes.label: Right-angled triangle trigonometric ratios
nodes.title: Definitions of sine, cosine and tangent as ratios of sides in a right-angled triangle.

nodes.label: Use of inverse trigonometric functions
nodes.title: Using $\sin^{-1}$, $\cos^{-1}$, and $\tan^{-1}$ to find angles given trigonometric ratios.

nodes.label: Unit circle and sign of trigonometric ratios
nodes.title: Using the unit circle to understand signs and values of sine, cosine, and tangent in different quadrants.

nodes.label: Sine Rule
nodes.title: Relates sides and opposite angles in any triangle: $\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C}$.

nodes.label: Area of triangle using sine
nodes.title: Area of triangle $= \frac{1}{2} ab \sin C$; half product of two sides times sine of included angle.

nodes.label: Cosine rule
nodes.title: Formula relating sides and included angle in any triangle: $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc \cos A$.

nodes.label: Trigonometry in three dimensions
nodes.title: Applying trigonometric principles (e.g., sine rule, cosine rule) to problems involving 3D geometric figures.

nodes.label: Graphs of sine, cosine and tangent functions
nodes.title: Plot and properties of the sine, cosine and tangent functions including period, range, and asymptotes.

nodes.label: Amplitude and period transformations of trigonometric graphs
nodes.title: Effects on trigonometric graph amplitude and period by multiplying or scaling input/output.

nodes.label: General solutions of trigonometric equations
nodes.title: Expressing all solutions to trig equations using general sums of reference angles and multiples of period.

nodes.label: Basic geometric definitions and properties
nodes.title: Fundamental geometric facts like angle sums on lines, vertically opposite angles, supplementary angles.

nodes.label: Triangle properties: equilateral, isosceles, right-angled
nodes.title: Characterizations of triangles based on side lengths and angle measures.

nodes.label: Pythagoras' theorem
nodes.title: In a right angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

nodes.label: Triangle congruence criteria
nodes.title: Conditions (SSS, ASA, SAS, RHS) for two triangles to be congruent (equal in shape and size).

nodes.label: Triangle inequality
nodes.title: Sum of any two sides of a triangle is greater than the third side.

nodes.label: Area of triangle
nodes.title: The area can be calculated using base multiplied by perpendicular height divided by 2.

nodes.label: Area of parallelogram
nodes.title: Area equals base times perpendicular height.

nodes.label: Transversals and parallel lines
nodes.title: Properties of parallel lines cut by transversals, including segments proportionality and angle relationships.

nodes.label: Line segment division in a given ratio
nodes.title: Finding coordinates of internal division point dividing a segment in ratio m:n.

nodes.label: Similarity of triangles
nodes.title: Triangles with equal corresponding angles and proportional sides.

nodes.label: Circle theorems: angle at centre and circumference
nodes.title: Angle subtended at centre is twice the angle at circumference on the same arc.

nodes.label: Circle tangent theorems
nodes.title: Tangents are perpendicular to radius at point of contact; tangents from a point are equal.

nodes.label: Equation of a circle centered at origin
nodes.title: Circle equation $x^2 + y^2 = r^2$ with center $(0,0)$ and radius $r$.

nodes.label: General equation of a circle
nodes.title: Equation in form $x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0$ with center $(-g,-f)$ and radius $\sqrt{g^2+f^2-c}$.

nodes.label: Finding equation of circle containing three points
nodes.title: Using perpendicular bisectors to find center and radius of circle through three given points.

nodes.label: Finding equation of a tangent to a circle
nodes.title: Computing tangent line equation at given point on circle using perpendicularity to radius.

nodes.label: Length of tangent from point to circle
nodes.title: Finding length of tangent from external point using Pythagoras theorem with radius and distance to center.

nodes.label: Points of intersection between line and circle
nodes.title: Solving simultaneous equations to find zero, one or two intersection points of a line and circle.

nodes.label: Common chord of two circles
nodes.title: Line through intersection points of two circles representing their common chord.

nodes.label: Exponential functions
nodes.title: Functions of the form $f(x) = A a^{x}$ modeling growth or decay processes.

nodes.label: Exponential growth and decay
nodes.title: Modeling increase or decrease of quantity exponentially using functions of form $A (1 \pm i)^t$.

nodes.label: Logarithmic functions and solving logarithmic equations
nodes.title: Inverting exponential functions via logarithms and solving equations using log rules.

nodes.label: Mathematical induction
nodes.title: Proof method proving statements for all natural numbers by verifying base case and inductive step.

nodes.label: Direct proof
nodes.title: Proof method using axioms, definitions, and previously proved results straightforwardly.

nodes.label: Abstract inequalities and their proofs
nodes.title: Proving inequalities by expressing in terms of squares and sign properties of real numbers.

nodes.label: Modulus function
nodes.title: Absolute value function mapping a real number to its non-negative magnitude.

nodes.label: Solving modular equations
nodes.title: Solving equations involving absolute value expressions by splitting into positive and negative cases.

nodes.label: Solving modular inequalities
nodes.title: Solving inequalities with absolute values by converting to compound inequalities or sets.

nodes.label: Differentiation from first principles
nodes.title: Finding the derivative of a function as the limit of the average rate of change over a small interval.

nodes.label: Power rule for differentiation
nodes.title: Derivative of $x^{n}$ is $n x^{n-1}$ for real number $n$.

nodes.label: Sum and difference rule for differentiation
nodes.title: The derivative of sum or difference is the sum or difference of derivatives.

nodes.label: Product rule
nodes.title: For $y=uv$, derivative is $u \frac{dv}{dx}+v \frac{du}{dx}$.

nodes.label: Quotient rule
nodes.title: For $y=\frac{u}{v}$, derivative is $\frac{v \frac{du}{dx} - u \frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}$.

nodes.label: Chain rule
nodes.title: For composite functions $y=f(u)$, $u=g(x)$, derivative is $\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{du} \cdot \frac{du}{dx}$.

nodes.label: Second derivative
nodes.title: The derivative of the derivative function, representing the rate of change of the rate of change.

nodes.label: Derivatives of sin, cos and tan functions
nodes.title: Basic derivatives: $\frac{d}{dx} \sin x = \cos x$, $\frac{d}{dx} \cos x = -\sin x$, $\frac{d}{dx} \tan x = \sec^2 x$.

nodes.label: Derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions
nodes.title: Derivatives of arcsin, arccos, arctan with respect to $x$, e.g. $\frac{d}{dx} \sin^{-1} \frac{x}{a} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}}$.

nodes.label: Derivatives of exponential functions
nodes.title: Derivative of $e^{x}$ is $e^{x}$, and more generally $\frac{d}{dx} e^{a x} = a e^{a x}$.

nodes.label: Derivatives of logarithmic functions
nodes.title: Derivative of natural logarithm: $\frac{d}{dx} \ln x = \frac{1}{x}$, and related rules for composite functions.

nodes.label: Imaginary Unit and Property i^2 = -1
nodes.title: Defines i as the square root of -1 and establishes i^2 = -1 as the foundational rule for complex arithmetic.

nodes.label: Complex Number in Cartesian Form a + bi
nodes.title: Represents complex numbers with real and imaginary parts and identifies Re(z) and Im(z).

nodes.label: Complex Conjugate and Division by a Complex Number
nodes.title: Uses the conjugate to rationalize denominators: z̄ = a − bi and z·z̄ = |z|^2 to divide complex numbers.

nodes.label: Equality of Complex Numbers
nodes.title: Determines equality by equating real parts and imaginary parts separately.

nodes.label: Argand Diagram and Modulus of a Complex Number
nodes.title: Plots complex numbers in the plane and computes modulus |z| = √(a^2 + b^2).

nodes.label: Transformations in the Complex Plane
nodes.title: Interprets addition as translation, multiplication by a real as scaling/reflection, and multiplication by i^k as rotation by k·90°.

nodes.label: Conjugate Roots Theorem
nodes.title: If a polynomial has real coefficients, complex roots occur in conjugate pairs.

nodes.label: Polar Form of a Complex Number
nodes.title: Represents z as r(cos θ + i sin θ) with r = |z| and θ = arg(z).

nodes.label: Products and Quotients in Polar Form
nodes.title: Multiplies moduli and adds arguments; divides moduli and subtracts arguments.

nodes.label: De Moivre’s Theorem
nodes.title: For integer n, (cos θ + i sin θ)^n = cos(nθ) + i sin(nθ).

nodes.label: nth Roots of Complex Numbers
nodes.title: Finds all n distinct roots z_k = r^{1/n}[cos((θ+2kπ)/n) + i sin((θ+2kπ)/n)].

nodes.label: Simplifying Surds by Extracting Perfect Squares
nodes.title: Simplifies radicals like √(ab) by factoring perfect squares: e.g., √18 = 3√2.

nodes.label: Constructing √2 and √3 on the Number Line
nodes.title: Uses compass and straightedge via right triangles to construct segments of irrational lengths.

nodes.label: Enlargement with Centre and Scale Factor
nodes.title: Maps points through rays from a centre; scale factor k>1 enlarges, 0<k<1 reduces; negative k reflects through centre.

nodes.label: Finding Centre of Enlargement
nodes.title: Joins corresponding object-image points and locates the intersection of lines as the centre.

nodes.label: Constructing a 60° Angle via Equilateral Triangle
nodes.title: Builds an equilateral triangle using compass to create a 60° angle.

nodes.label: Tangent to a Circle at a Point
nodes.title: Constructs a tangent by drawing the radius to the point and the perpendicular line.

nodes.label: Circumcentre and Circumcircle of a Triangle
nodes.title: Finds the circumcentre by intersecting perpendicular bisectors and draws the circle through vertices.

nodes.label: Incentre and Incircle of a Triangle
nodes.title: Finds the incentre via angle bisectors and constructs the incircle tangent to all sides.

nodes.label: Centroid of a Triangle via Medians
nodes.title: Constructs medians and locates their concurrency point as the centroid.

nodes.label: Orthocentre of a Triangle via Altitudes
nodes.title: Constructs altitudes and locates their point of concurrency as the orthocentre.

nodes.label: Power Rule for Antidifferentiation
nodes.title: Integrates powers of x: ∫x^n dx = x^{n+1}/(n+1) + C for n ≠ -1.

nodes.label: Linearity of Integration
nodes.title: Integrates sums and scalar multiples term-by-term: ∫(af+bg) = a∫f + b∫g.

nodes.label: Integrals of Exponential Functions
nodes.title: Computes ∫e^{ax} dx = e^{ax}/a + C and ∫a^x dx = a^x/ln a + C.

nodes.label: Integrals of Sine and Cosine
nodes.title: Computes ∫sin(ax) dx = −cos(ax)/a + C and ∫cos(ax) dx = sin(ax)/a + C.

nodes.label: Integrating ln x via Reverse Product Rule
nodes.title: Uses derivative of x ln x − x to obtain ∫ln x dx = x ln x − x + C.

nodes.label: Kinematics via Integration
nodes.title: Integrates acceleration to velocity and velocity to displacement with constants from initial conditions.

nodes.label: Definite Integral and Area Under a Curve
nodes.title: Evaluates ∫_a^b f(x) dx via antiderivatives; interprets signed area between curve and x-axis.

nodes.label: Area Between Two Curves
nodes.title: Computes area by integrating the difference: ∫_a^b [g(x) − f(x)] dx where g is above f.

nodes.label: Average Value of a Function on [a,b]
nodes.title: Computes average height as (1/(b−a)) ∫_a^b f(x) dx.

nodes.label: Equation of a Tangent Line Using the Derivative
nodes.title: Finds slope via f′(x_0) and uses point-slope form y − y_0 = m(x − x_0).

nodes.label: Increasing and Decreasing Functions via f′(x)
nodes.title: Determines monotonicity from the sign of the derivative on intervals.

nodes.label: Stationary Points and Second Derivative Test
nodes.title: Finds critical points f′(x)=0 and classifies maxima/minima using f″(x).

nodes.label: Point of Inflection and Concavity Change
nodes.title: Identifies where f″(x)=0 with a sign change as an inflection point; tangent may cross the curve.

nodes.label: Optimization with Calculus
nodes.title: Formulates a function to maximize or minimize subject to constraints using derivatives.

nodes.label: Related Rates via Chain Rule
nodes.title: Relates time derivatives of connected quantities using dy/dt = (dy/du)(du/dt).

nodes.label: Compound Interest Future Value
nodes.title: Uses F = P(1+i)^t to compute accumulated amount with compound interest.

nodes.label: Present Value Discounting
nodes.title: Uses P = F/(1+i)^t to discount a future amount to present value.

nodes.label: Effective Monthly Rate from AER
nodes.title: Converts annual effective rate i to monthly rate r via (1+r)^{12} = 1+i.

nodes.label: Future Value of an Annuity (Annuity-Due)
nodes.title: For payments at period starts, F = P(1+i)[(1+i)^t − 1]/i.

nodes.label: Present Value of an Annuity (Level Payments)
nodes.title: Discounts a stream of end-of-period payments: PV = P[1 − (1+i)^{−t}]/i.

nodes.label: Loan/Mortgage Fixed Repayment Formula
nodes.title: Computes payment A = P·i(1+i)^t / [(1+i)^t − 1] for a level-payment loan.

nodes.label: Area of a Trapezium
nodes.title: Calculates area as A = ((a + b)/2)·h for parallel sides a, b and height h.

nodes.label: Volume of a Frustum of a Cone by Subtraction
nodes.title: Finds frustum volume as difference of two cone volumes with common apex.

nodes.label: Measurement Error and Percentage Error
nodes.title: Computes absolute, relative, and percentage errors; interprets tolerance (± half the smallest unit).

nodes.label: Tree Diagrams and Multiplication Rule
nodes.title: Represents sequential events; multiplies branch probabilities for joint outcomes.

nodes.label: Expected Value of a Discrete Random Variable
nodes.title: Computes E(X) = Σ x·P(x) and assesses fairness by comparing expected payoff with cost.

nodes.label: Binomial Distribution for Bernoulli Trials
nodes.title: Models r successes in n independent trials with P(X=r) = C(n,r)p^r(1−p)^{n−r}.

nodes.label: First Success on the nth Trial (Geometric Setting)
nodes.title: Computes P(first success on n) = (1−p)^{n−1} p.

nodes.label: kth Success on the nth Trial (Negative Binomial Setting)
nodes.title: Probability the kth success occurs on trial n via C(n−1,k−1)p^k(1−p)^{n−k}.

nodes.label: Independence Test via P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B)
nodes.title: Determines independence of events by comparing joint probability to product of marginals.

nodes.label: Combinatorial Probability with Permutations and Combinations
nodes.title: Counts outcomes in sampling without replacement using nCr and nPr to compute probabilities.

nodes.label: Probability Simulation
nodes.title: Uses random devices or generators to model chance processes and estimate probabilities.

nodes.label: Functions: Domain, Codomain, and Range
nodes.title: Defines the input set, potential output set, and actual outputs of a function.

nodes.label: Vertical Line Test for Functions
nodes.title: Determines if a graph represents a function by checking that vertical lines intersect it at most once.

nodes.label: Composition of Functions
nodes.title: Forms a new function by applying g after f: (g∘f)(x) = g(f(x)); generally non-commutative.

nodes.label: Injective, Surjective, and Bijective Functions
nodes.title: Classifies functions as one-to-one, onto, or both; uses horizontal line tests and mapping diagrams.

nodes.label: Inverse Function and Reflection in y = x
nodes.title: Finds f^{-1} algebraically and understands graph as reflection over the line y = x; requires bijection on the domain.

nodes.label: Completing the Square for Quadratics
nodes.title: Rewrites ax^2+bx+c into a(x−h)^2 + k to find vertex and facilitate graphing.

nodes.label: Sketching Quadratic and Cubic Functions
nodes.title: Uses intercepts, turning points, symmetry, and end behavior to produce rough graphs.

nodes.label: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions as Inverses
nodes.title: Recognizes y = a^x and y = log_a x as inverse functions with characteristic asymptotes.

nodes.label: Graph Transformations of Functions
nodes.title: Applies vertical shifts f(x)±a, horizontal shifts f(x±a), reflections f(−x), −f(x), and vertical scaling af(x).

nodes.label: Scatter Plots and Correlation
nodes.title: Visualizes bivariate data to assess positive, negative, or no linear relationship; distinguishes correlation from causation.

nodes.label: Pearson Product-Moment Correlation Coefficient r
nodes.title: Measures strength and direction of linear association; interprets r in [−1,1].

nodes.label: Line of Best Fit (Least Squares Line by Estimation)
nodes.title: Draws a trend line by eye and finds its equation to model linear relationships and make predictions.

nodes.label: Empirical Rule (68–95–99.7 Rule)
nodes.title: Approximates normal distribution coverage within 1, 2, and 3 standard deviations of the mean.

nodes.label: Z-Scores (Standard Scores)
nodes.title: Converts x to standard units z = (x − μ)/σ for comparison and probability calculation.

nodes.label: Standard Normal Probability from Tables
nodes.title: Finds P(Z ≤ z), P(Z ≥ z), and P(a ≤ Z ≤ b) and performs inverse lookups for given areas.

nodes.label: Standardization of Normal Variables
nodes.title: Converts probabilities involving X~N(μ,σ^2) to Z using z = (x − μ)/σ.

nodes.label: Central Limit Theorem for Sample Means
nodes.title: States that for large n, the sampling distribution of x̄ is approximately normal with mean μ and standard error σ/√n.

nodes.label: Confidence Interval for a Population Proportion (Exact 95%)
nodes.title: Uses p̂ ± 1.96·√(p̂(1−p̂)/n) to estimate the true proportion at 95% confidence.

nodes.label: Margin of Error Approximation for Proportions
nodes.title: Approximates 95% margin of error by E ≈ 1/√n for quick interval estimates.

nodes.label: Hypothesis Test for a Population Proportion (z-test)
nodes.title: Tests H0: p = p0 using z = (p̂ − p0)/√(p0(1−p0)/n) with 5% critical regions.

nodes.label: Confidence Interval for a Population Mean (Known σ, 95%)
nodes.title: Uses x̄ ± 1.96·σ/√n to estimate the population mean at 95% confidence.

nodes.label: Hypothesis Test for a Population Mean (z-test, Known σ)
nodes.title: Tests H0: μ = μ0 using z = (x̄ − μ0)/(σ/√n) with two-sided 5% critical regions ±1.96.

nodes.label: p-Value Interpretation in Hypothesis Testing
nodes.title: Computes the probability of observing a test statistic as extreme as the sample under H0 and compares to α.

nodes.label: Unique Output Property of Functions
nodes.title: Recognizing that a function is a relation that assigns exactly one output to each input.

nodes.label: Graphing Linear Functions y = ax + b
nodes.title: Plotting the graph of a linear function in the coordinate plane for equations of the form y = ax + b.

nodes.label: Slope-Intercept Form y = ax + b (Rational Coefficients)
nodes.title: Understanding linear functions written as y = ax + b where a and b are rational numbers and x is real.

nodes.label: Graphical Representation of Contextual Linear Relationships
nodes.title: Representing linear relationships from real-world contexts using graphs and connecting the equation y = ax + b to the plotted representation.

nodes.label: Definition of a Function (Well-Defined Mapping)
nodes.title: Understanding that a function assigns exactly one output to each input in its domain.

nodes.label: Injective Function (One-to-One)
nodes.title: A function where distinct inputs yield distinct outputs.

nodes.label: Surjective Function (Onto)
nodes.title: A function whose range equals its codomain.

nodes.label: Bijective Function
nodes.title: A function that is both injective and surjective and therefore has a two-sided inverse.

nodes.label: Find the Inverse of a Bijective Function
nodes.title: Algebraically compute f^{-1}(x) for a bijective function, including swapping domain and range.

nodes.label: Sketch the Graph of an Inverse Function by Reflecting in y = x
nodes.title: Given the graph of a function, obtain the graph of its inverse via reflection across the line y = x.

nodes.label: Function Composition
nodes.title: Form and evaluate composite functions (f ∘ g)(x) and determine the resulting domain.

nodes.label: Interpret f(x) = g(x) as Intersection of Graphs
nodes.title: Understand that solutions to f(x) = g(x) are x-values where the graphs of f and g intersect.

nodes.label: Solve f(x) = 0 Graphically
nodes.title: Approximate roots by locating the x-intercepts of the graph of f.

nodes.label: Solve f(x) = k Graphically
nodes.title: Find approximate solutions by intersecting the graph of f with the horizontal line y = k.

nodes.label: Solve f(x) = g(x) Graphically
nodes.title: Approximate solutions by identifying intersection points of the graphs of f and g.

nodes.label: Graph Linear Functions y = ax + b
nodes.title: Plot lines with rational coefficients, identifying slope and y-intercept.

nodes.label: Graph Quadratic Functions y = ax^2 + bx + c
nodes.title: Plot parabolas with rational coefficients; identify vertex, axis of symmetry, and intercepts.

nodes.label: Completing the Square for Quadratic Functions
nodes.title: Rewrite ax^2 + bx + c in the form a(x + h)^2 + k to reveal vertex and facilitate solving.

nodes.label: Find Roots of a Quadratic from Completed Square Form
nodes.title: Solve for x using the completed square form to determine real roots, including multiplicities.

nodes.label: Find Turning Point of a Quadratic from Completed Square Form
nodes.title: Identify the vertex (-h, k) directly from a quadratic in a(x + h)^2 + k form.

nodes.label: Sketch a Quadratic Using Completed Square Form
nodes.title: Use vertex, axis of symmetry, intercepts, and concavity from the completed square form to sketch the parabola.

nodes.label: Graph Cubic Functions y = ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d
nodes.title: Sketch cubic graphs with integer or rational coefficients, noting end behavior and possible turning points.

nodes.label: Graph Exponential Functions y = a b^x
nodes.title: Plot exponential functions (a ≠ 0, b > 0, b ≠ 1), showing horizontal asymptotes and growth or decay.

nodes.label: Graph Logarithmic Functions
nodes.title: Plot logarithmic functions y = log_b(x) (b > 0, b ≠ 1), noting domain, vertical asymptote, and inverse relation to exponentials.

nodes.label: Graph Basic Trigonometric Functions
nodes.title: Graph y = sin x, y = cos x, and y = tan x, identifying amplitude, period, and key features.

nodes.label: Informal Limit of a Function
nodes.title: Explore the value that f(x) approaches as x nears a point using graphs or numerical tables.

nodes.label: Informal Continuity of a Function
nodes.title: Understand that a function is continuous at a point if the limit equals the function value and the graph has no break there.

nodes.label: Derivative from First Principles (Limit Definition)
